candidates.label: Flood-fill continents ('l'=land), horizontal wraparound (col N-1 adjacent to col 0, no row wrap), excludes the king's own continent, outputs biggest remaining continent size (0 if none).

Forgets the horizontal wraparound entirely (treats grid as a plain non-wrapping grid) -- both existing samples happen to give the same answer with or without wrap, so this is a real candidate for exposing a coverage gap.

Never excludes the king's own continent -- just outputs the single largest continent overall. On both existing cases the king's own continent happens to be tied-or-smaller than the true answer, so this bug is also currently undetectable.
